description: Implementation of a socket adaptor class for UNIX domain sockets, handling connection setup, data transfer, listening, and threading.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: A class managing UNIX domain socket connections, data transfer, and threading for socket communication.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Establishes a UNIX socket connection to a specified path.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into an internal buffer.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from the internal buffer.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming socket connections on a specified path.

methods.name: stop_listening
methods.description: Stops listening and cleans up socket resources.

methods.name: worker_thread
methods.description: Thread function that monitors socket and control pipe for events.

methods.name: process_control_message
methods.description: Handles control messages from the control pipe.

methods.name: get_active_connections
methods.description: Returns the number of active socket connections.

methods.name: register_data_ready_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for data readiness events.
